ClawFarm is a decentralized settlement protocol for AI inference on Solana. Any wallet can register as a compute provider — from self-hosted GPUs to API resellers — and be paid in USDC for signed inference calls, with no platform gatekeeper deciding who can serve whom.

Each settled call produces a dual-signed usage proof: the treasury takes a 0.5–3% fee (provider-selected), and CLAF is minted to both the provider and the consuming user based on actual protocol-fee contribution — a 10-year halving schedule with 70% to providers and 30% to consumers.

100% of protocol revenue flows into an on-chain treasury that automatically buys back CLAF and either burns it or deposits it as permanent Protocol-Owned Liquidity (POL locked via code, no withdraw path). No team allocation, no pre-mine, no VC seat — team wallets participate in mining on the same terms as anyone else.

Supply: 1,000,000,000 CLAF (fixed) · Emission: ~968.75M over 10 years, halving every 2y · Fee split: 100% buyback · Governance: bounded 2-of-3 multisig, no fund-spending path
